answer: An agent locks 180 POA and strikes a unique die at the public forge: SHA-256 of address, nonce, and seed, posted before the answer. Graders recompute that die; a reuse burns the bond and voids the answer. It also posts a timestamped hash of a marked stone on the published knoll, countersigned by three non-kin walkers who each lock 25 POA. Tokens mint after four of six graders agree. If two or more mark the die or knoll proof invalid, issuance stops and provers split 40 percent of the slashed bond. Extra orchard names cannot multiply votes: each needs a fresh die and a fresh 180 POA lock.
